purpose: Increase precision under the synthesis deadline while explicitly accepting reduced recall.
historical_interpretation: This is a changed prospective selection policy. It preserves and does not invalidate prior screening outcomes.

approved_scope_changes: Surveys, reviews, and broad overviews are excluded from the current synthesis and retained in a separate H2H3/background list.
Eligible research reports must describe or evaluate a specific qualifying system or workflow; they need not introduce a new system.

Advancement requires explicit supplied evidence connecting the human analytical task, visual interaction or an analytically meaningful visual representation, and substantive computational assistance in the same workflow.

policy_rules: Infrastructure, data hosting, browser construction, rendering or streaming performance, and generic support for downstream analysis do not by themselves establish the required integrated analytical workflow.
Do not infer integration merely because a report mentions both AI and visualization or combines a chatbot with a static explanatory image.
Clinical, monitoring, operational, and health-administration analysis may qualify; research use is not mandatory.

AI or machine learning is not mandatory. Qualifying computation may include clustering, statistical analysis, simulation, optimization, registration, or similar methods when integrated into the analytical workflow.
A defensible scientific NO or explicit contradictory workflow evidence yields EXCLUDED.
Missing or ambiguous evidence yields UNCERTAIN with DEFER, not an invented negative judgment.
Advance only clearly supported candidates. There is no INCLUDE quota, target yield, or category balancing.

model_input_policy: Use only the original supplied title and abstract evidence units. Do not supply prior judgments, model summaries, expected outcomes, or enriched evidence.
